title: Planned footprints (assets/build/planned/<name>.json)
description: Buildings and ships whose models are made before the content defines them (D-056 model sessions). The asset build reads every planned file beneath content/<region> (content wins per ID), so recipes validate and build before the content lands. Remove an entry once the content has it (optional: content wins anyway).

id.description: The content ID the content session will use (CONTENT §7/§8).

kind.description: house: a residence; producer: a production building (cart point; chimney and smoke when smoke is true); service: a public building with a radius; farm: a producer with fields or pasture modules; module: a pasture module (field kind, animals); field: a one-tile crop or meadow field; ship: a ship type (footprint null).

footprint.description: Width × depth in tiles (CONTENT §7); null for ships.

water_tiles.description: Water rows at the far end (harbour buildings, D-051); 0 elsewhere.

slot.description: Deposit type of a slot building (requires_deposit), or null.

smoke.description: Producers that burn or cook: the model needs chimney and smoke anchors (default false).

slots.description: Ships: cargo slots (CONTENT §8); the cargo attachment shows one prop per slot.

levels.description: Number of model levels (<id>.l<n>.glb). The only field read for an ID the content already defines, and only while the content declares no levels for it (market, D-056 §3).
